Strategy: Reward residuals between twenty-five and forty while penalizing residuals between five and twenty, a shifted sweet-plus-penalty combination. This steers bins toward reusable middle leftovers and away from small awkward gaps, but both limits are guesses and the penalty may hurt genuinely tight fits.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 25 and r - item <= 40 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 5 and r - item <= 20 else 0) for r in bins]
```
